headline: On last trading session, Indian stock market extended its multi-week rally as Sensex and Nifty hit 9-month highs.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Record foreign institutional investor (FII) buying supported the extended 4-week rally in Indian equities.
Auto and banking stocks drove strong recovery gains, boosting Nifty back above key levels.
Concerns over Federal Reserve rate hike signals and a global AI sell-off triggered interim market pullbacks.
Gold witnessed a sharp sell-off, dropping to its lowest level of 2026 and threatening its 5-year winning streak.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty touched 9-month highs as the market extended its 4-week winning streak.
Adani Group announced its entry into West Bengal's power sector, prompting political calls for transparency.
Benchmark indices experienced volatile swings, including a nearly 1,000-point surge in Sensex during mid-week trade.
NSE stock price rallied 5% on heavy volumes, marking a 35% recovery from its October low.
summary: The Indian stock market extended its 4-week rally in recent sessions, with Sensex and Nifty touching 9-month highs supported by record FII buying. Despite volatility caused by global AI sell-offs and US Fed rate hike concerns, auto and bank stocks led strong recoveries. Meanwhile, Adani Group made headlines with its expansion into West Bengal's power sector.
